batchHelp: Select Export on library cards, or select all project WAVs. Originals and references are preserved.
renameCopies: Add a suffix to the new copy
includeManifest: Save a portable JSON metadata manifest
includePrompts: Include prompts in the manifest. I reviewed them for private information.
exportPrivacy: References are excluded. The manifest omits source paths, environments and credentials. Prompts are excluded unless explicitly selected. Unknown metadata stays unknown.
manifestFailed: WAV results are listed above, but the manifest could not be saved.
exportError_source_changed: Source hash changed; the unverified copy was removed
exportError_copy_failed: Copy failed; a partial output may remain. Check disk space and permissions before retrying.
exportError_source_unavailable_or_change: Source missing, changed or in trash; check the original
exportError_destination_io_error: Destination unavailable; check disk space and permissions
queueIdleHelp: Request audio through Codex or render an existing WAV in FX. Accepted tasks appear here.
musicPresetHelp: Reusable generation settings, separate from DSP presets. Capture a result, review values and direct their use through Codex/MCP.
presetChooseProject: Select a project to consult or capture music presets.
captureMusicResult: Capture settings from a music result
noMusicResultForPreset: No result with recognized music-engine parameters in this project yet. DSP and voice use separate presets/profiles.
noMusicPresets: No music presets saved in this project. Capture a result or ask Codex to save an explicit engine-compatible configuration.
presetDirection: Parameters are read only here. Ask Codex to adjust creative direction or save a new configuration revision. This view never starts generation automatically.
presetReviewed: Current values reviewed. No task was queued. In Codex, prepare an explicit repeat or variation and confirm its review token before generating.
presetSeedWarning: Reusing settings is different from repeating a generation or creating a variation. A variation requires a different seed. Seeds do not guarantee identical audio across checkpoints or environments.
musicPresetSaved: Music preset saved; no audio generated.
loopHelp: Select a region and overlap its tail with its head. The new cycle is shorter by the crossfade duration. No AI model or automatic beat alignment is used.
chooseLoopSource: Select a project WAV in Source & versions to prepare a loop.
loopPreviewDuration: The preview repeats the complete edited cycle: {{duration}} s total. Maximum: ten minutes.
invalidLoop: Choose a region of at least 0.1 seconds within the source. Crossfade must fit within half the region.
zeroCrossfade: Without crossfade this is a crop only; the seam may click.
loopPreviewQueued: Loop preview queued. Listen to the repetitions before creating the final version.
loopListenHelp: Listen to the preview in Source & versions or the player. Render one cycle when satisfied, then export it as WAV. Mono input produces dual-mono stereo output. Some music needs a different region; a perfect musical loop is not guaranteed.
